profile.summary: Based on the limited but focused contributions to the Express.js repository, @aheckmann demonstrates strong expertise in Node.js backend development, particularly with Express.js. Their work primarily revolves around HTTP response handling, middleware configuration, and app lifecycle management, showcasing deep knowledge of Express's core patterns. While no frontend contributions or TypeScript usage are visible in this dataset, their backend-focused experience is evident through careful handling of edge cases (e.g., `res.send(undefined)` responses) and configuration inheritance. The contributions suggest a Mid-level developer with specialized knowledge in Express's internals and RESTful API design, though broader JavaScript ecosystem experience (e.g., frontend frameworks, testing, or modern tooling) cannot be confirmed from this data alone.
